abstract: axi_uart_periph 是一个基于 AXI4-Lite 可配置的 UART 外设，提供发送、接收、可编程波特率、TX/RX FIFO、状态寄存器与中断，面向 SoC 低速串口通信与调试场景。

clock_reset.clock_description: system clock, rising edge triggers all sequential logic
clock_reset.reset_value_requirement: All output ports (except AXI ready/resp) must have defined values, no X/Z; uart_tx=1 during reset and idle; irq=0 during reset

files.responsibility: AXI-Lite slave + CSR + reg side effects
divider to baud_tick and oversample tick
detect start, sample bits at midpoints, assemble byte

files.rtl/modules/axi_lite_regs.sv: AXI-Lite slave + CSR + reg side effects
files.rtl/modules/baud_gen.sv: divider to baud_tick and oversample tick
files.rtl/modules/uart_rx.sv: detect start, sample bits at midpoints, assemble byte

goals.description: 实现 8N1 UART（8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit），支持可选奇偶校验（可配置开关）
提供 AXI-Lite CSR（寄存器读写、状态查询、清中断）
支持可编程波特率（分频器），支持运行时改波特率
提供 TX/RX FIFO（深度参数化），并产生相应状态/中断
提供一个最小可用 testbench，覆盖基本收发、寄存器访问、中断与边界场景

constraints.value: must provide default assignment for all outputs/next-state
All output ports must have defined values during reset, no X/Z
Only single outstanding read/write transactions supported
All logic in single clk domain, no CDC handling

soft_preferences.value: 8N1 default (8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.side_effects: EN=0 disables UART (TX idle, RX disabled)

registers.name: BAUD
registers.side_effects: New baud rate takes effect for subsequent frames

registers.name: STAT
registers.description: fifo status, busy flags, error flags

registers.name: TXDATA
registers.side_effects: Write enqueues byte to TX FIFO; returns SLVERR if FIFO full

registers.name: RXDATA
registers.side_effects: Read pops byte from RX FIFO

functional_requirements.statement: When rst_n==0, the design shall reset all CSRs to their reset values and drive uart_tx=1, irq=0.
When SW writes TXDATA and TX FIFO is not full, the byte shall be enqueued and eventually transmitted on uart_tx.
functional_requirements.corner: TX FIFO full 时返回 SLVERR

functional_requirements.statement: When a valid UART frame is received, the byte shall be pushed into RX FIFO. If RX FIFO is full, set RX_OVERRUN and drop the incoming byte.
irq shall assert whenever an enabled interrupt condition is true and remain asserted until the condition is cleared.
When SW updates BAUD divider, the new baud rate shall take effect for subsequent frames.

non_goals.description: 不实现 DMA、不实现多串口通道
不要求严格兼容 16550 寄存器布局（但允许参考其语义）
不处理多时钟域 CDC；所有逻辑均处于 clk 域
不提供 UVM 环境；仅要求最小可运行 testbench

rules.statement: Only single outstanding read/write transactions supported
awready/wready/arready allowed to deassert when internal busy
bvalid given 1~N cycles after AW and W handshake complete
Only word-aligned addresses supported; misaligned returns SLVERR
TXDATA write enqueues byte to TX FIFO; returns SLVERR if FIFO full
Frame format: start=0, 8 data bits (LSB first), optional parity, 1 stop bit
RX oversampling with OVERSAMPLE=16 default, sample at mid-bit
RX FIFO full on new byte sets RX_OVERRUN and drops byte
baud_tick generated per bit time boundary

requirement_specs.statement: When rst_n==0, the design shall reset all CSRs to their reset values and drive uart_tx=1, irq=0.
When SW writes TXDATA and TX FIFO is not full, the byte shall be enqueued and eventually transmitted on uart_tx.
When a valid UART frame is received, the byte shall be pushed into RX FIFO. If RX FIFO is full, set RX_OVERRUN and drop the incoming byte.
irq shall assert whenever an enabled interrupt condition is true and remain asserted until the condition is cleared.
When SW updates BAUD divider, the new baud rate shall take effect for subsequent frames.

test_specs_v2.purpose: Verify reset values and reset outputs are not X
Verify TXDATA write produces correct TX frame (8N1)
Verify RX receive and read RXDATA
Verify RX overrun when FIFO full
Verify baud update takes effect on next frame
checks: Two frames have different bit intervals

property_specs.statement: When RX_IRQ_EN && !RX_EMPTY, irq must be high
FIFO count shall not exceed bounds

implementation_nodes.goal: Create directory tree, Makefile, scripts, placeholder modules
gates: make sim completes compilation entry verification

implementation_nodes.goal: Implement uart_tx FSM + FIFO pop + frame output
Implement irq logic and error clearing

code_anchors.purpose: AXI write response with SLVERR on TX FIFO full
code_anchors.code:
always_comb begin
    bresp_n = 2'b00;
    tx_fifo_push = 1'b0;
    if (wr_fire) begin
        unique case (wr_addr)
            TXDATA_ADDR: begin
                if (!tx_full) begin
                    tx_fifo_push = 1'b1;
                    tx_fifo_wdata = wdata[7:0];
                end else begin
                    bresp_n = 2'b10; // SLVERR
                end
            end
        endcase
    end
end

code_anchors.purpose: UART RX byte injection task for testbench
Reset behavior for CSRs and outputs
RX FIFO push with overrun handling

code_anchors.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
iverilog -g2012 -o sim.out \
  rtl/pkg/uart_pkg.sv \
  rtl/modules/fifo_sync.sv \
  rtl/modules/baud_gen.sv \
  rtl/modules/uart_tx.sv \
  rtl/modules/uart_rx.sv \
  rtl/modules/axi_lite_regs.sv \
  rtl/axi_uart_top.sv \
  tb/axi_uart_tb.sv
vvp sim.out

module axi_uart_top #(
    parameter int ADDR_W = 16,
    parameter int DATA_W = 32,
    parameter int FIFO_DEPTH = 16,
    parameter int OVERSAMPLE = 16
) (
    input  logic clk, rst_n,
    input  logic [ADDR_W-1:0] s_axi_awaddr, s_axi_araddr,
    input  logic s_axi_awvalid, s_axi_wvalid, s_axi_wstrb, s_axi_bready,
    input  logic s_axi_arvalid, s_axi_rready,
    input  logic [DATA_W-1:0] s_axi_wdata,
    input  logic uart_rx,
    output logic s_axi_awready, s_axi_wready, s_axi_bvalid,
    output logic s_axi_arready, s_axi_rvalid,
    output logic [1:0] s_axi_bresp, s_axi_rresp,
    output logic [DATA_W-1:0] s_axi_rdata,
    output logic uart_tx, irq
);

implementation_hints.statement: 该节应视为全文的硬前提，下游章节不得与本节冲突。
若 agent 从现有仓库反推 spec，应优先从顶层模块、构建脚本与 lint 配置中抽取本节内容。
摘要中的能力项必须能在后续章节中找到对应落点：接口、REQ、CSR、TEST。
Goals 应尽量映射到可验证的对象：端口、寄存器、状态机、测试。
Non-goals 应优先用于约束 agent，防止其引入未要求的复杂机制。
术语表中的关键名词应尽量与代码中的信号名、状态名、寄存器字段名保持一致。
本节建议优先由顶层实例化关系、文件名、包依赖关系自动抽取。
当从仓库代码提炼 spec 时，应优先搜索 reset 分支中的赋值，提取复位值与初始态。
从仓库自动生成 spec 时，应补充 port width 的参数化来源（如 ADDR_W, DATA_W）。
若仓库实现中 AXI-Lite 行为分散在多个 always block，应在 spec 中统一抽象为读路径、写路径、响应路径三个契约对象。
若仓库中已经存在 UART model 或 monitor，应在 spec 中优先吸收其帧格式与采样假设。
参数定义建议由 package 或顶层参数唯一承载，不应在多个模块中重复硬编码。
建议每条 REQ 都映射到至少一个测试编号；如条件适合，再映射到一个自然语言 property。
建议在 spec 中同时写出读写语义与副作用语义，例如 RXDATA 读取是否 pop、IRQ_STAT 是否 RW1C。
若仓库实现中 TX/RX 被写成一个合并模块，spec 仍建议拆分为发送路径/接收路径两个逻辑职责。
建议测试条目与 REQ 编号做显式映射。
若仓库代码中已存在 assert/cover/checker module，应直接映射为 Assertions 小节内容。
节点设计的目标是先保证骨架可编译，再逐步闭合行为；不要在 Node-00/01 过早实现所有功能。
